title: Emission phase of the prefix emitter
statement: Let $w,x$ be Boolean words. For every natural number $i\le |w|$, after $i$ steps from the prefix emitter's initial configuration on input $x$, its control state is $i$, its input head remains at position $1$, and its output is the prefix of $w$ of length $i$.
replaced:
For every $i \le \abs{w}$, after $i$ steps from its initial configuration on
input $x$ the fixed-prefix emitter for $w$ is in control state $i$, the input
head has not moved, and the output is the first $i$ bits of $w$.
